certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — IFRS 16 Leases

learning_outcomes.text: Determine whether a contract is, or contains, a lease
Measure a lessee's right-of-use asset and lease liability at commencement
Account for subsequent measurement, interest and depreciation for a lessee
Apply the recognition exemptions for short-term and low-value leases
Classify and account for leases from a lessor's perspective
Account for reassessments, modifications and sale-and-leaseback transactions

integrative_case: A logistics company leases warehouses, forklifts and a small fleet of vehicles, some with purchase options and index-linked rents, and later sells and leases back its head office; determine which contracts are leases, measure the lessee entries, apply the exemptions where available, and explain the lessor treatment for the one asset it leases out.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
